method: Serial tests; fresh P-256 public-key import each operation. Synthetic DER signature conversion, JSON/binary parsing, two SHA-256 hashes, RP/origin/challenge/UP/UV subset checks and ES256 verify. Session-crypto case adds two random tokens and SHA-256 hashes, no sessions or D1. Node process user+system CPU is quantized on Windows. workerd CPU and all deployed timings unavailable. Host wall time includes JSON dispatch/body consumption for workerd. Batches contain 100 serial operations; divided means are not per-request percentiles. No browser, real credential, CBOR registration, replay store, authorization or full WebAuthn validation.
